plain_english_explanation: This email impersonates executive leadership demanding an immediate confidential wire transfer under an artificial deadline to bypass standard corporate accounting controls.
submitted_content: URGENT: I am in an executive board meeting. I need an immediate confidential wire of $24,500 processed for vendor acquisition. Do not call my phone, reply directly to this email with wire confirmation.

tactics_detected: Channel Isolation ('Do not call my phone')
highlighted_quotes: I need an immediate confidential wire of $24,500
Do not call my phone, reply directly to this email

why_dangerous.title: Bypasses Fiscal Governance Controls
why_dangerous.description: Exploits perceived executive hierarchy to coerce immediate financial departure from standard approval protocols.

recommended_actions: DO NOT execute the wire transfer or disclose banking details.
Verify the request through an established internal out-of-band communication channel.
Report the message to your organization's IT Security / SOC team.
